tradition.name: Trap pesado
tradition.lineage: Heavy Brazilian trap production represented by WIU’s self-produced 808 Club branch.

extras.description: WIU’s 808 Club marks a deliberate return to a concentrated trap sound after broader stylistic experiments. In his CNN interview he describes self-producing Luísa Sonza and using a lower, near-whispered delivery; São Paulo is the documented early-career setting recalled by that track. The authored model sets an intimate rap lead over long 808-style low end and short synth figures. Heavy here describes the selected production branch, not a requirement for shouted vocals or metal guitar.

geo_rationale: Selected documented practice center, not an exclusive origin or boundary of the discovery category.
